newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals find support after weak open.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals find support after weak open.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures found some support early Tuesday, after a weak opening, with platinum group metals recovering from news overnight that the Russian export agency, Almaz, was in talks with customers on resuming PGM exports.

COMEX June gold was up 90 cents at $349.60 after the first hour of trade, within a $348.00-350.10 early range, but a close above $350.00 was needed if the rally of the past few trading session was to continue, traders said.
In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted 4348.50/00, compared to the London Tuesday morning fix at $347.30 an ounce, and the New York close Monday around $347.40/90.
